item.title: United States wins 3rd Olympic gold in women’s hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller’s OT goal
item.description: Megan Keller backhanded in a shot 4:07 into overtime and the United States won its third Olympic gold medal in women’s hockey, beating Canada 2-1 at the Milan Cortina Games on Thursday.

item.title: Alysa Liu dazzles to win figure skating gold, ending 24-year Olympic drought for U.S. women
item.description: Alysa Liu delivered the U.S. its first women’s figure skating Olympic gold medal in 24 years, performing a near-flawless free skate on Thursday.

item.title: Bill meant to review unfunded mandates on public schools advances
item.description: OLYMPIA — A bill addressing the unfunded and underfunded mandates placed on Washington’s public schools has passed the state House of Representatives. With HB 2636, the mounting mandates will come under regular review to ensure they are serving schools and their students — and not causing more harm than good.

item.title: Memorial services for Rev. Jesse Jackson expanded to include South Carolina and Washington, DC
item.description: CHICAGO — Memorial services honoring the life of the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. will be expanded beyond Chicago with events in Washington, D.C., and South Carolina, the late civil rights leader's organization announced Thursday.

item.title: Trump administration eliminates reservations at Yosemite National Park this summer
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. — Three years after massive crowds during the July 4 weekend caused three-hour traffic jams and gridlock stretching for miles at Yosemite National Park, the Trump administration has eliminated rules designed to limit crowds by requiring visitors to obtain reservations to enter the park during busy summer days.

item.title: Investigators search Battle Ground home linked to wildlife shootings
item.description: Battle Ground police detectives served a search warrant Tuesday at a home connected to a monthslong investigation into the shooting of various neighborhood wildlife with blow darts.

item.title: 4A State Gymnastics: Carly Christ of Union sixth in all-around, Camas third in team standings
item.description: Carly Christ of Union tied for sixth place in the all-around and Camas finished third in the team standings at the first day of the Class 4A state gymnastics championships Thursday in Bellevue.

item.title: Boys Basketball Roundup: Late steal and score lifts Union over Bonney Lake in loser-out game
item.description: Grant Brown came up with a steal and layup with 27 seconds left to lift Union to 70-69 win over Bonney Lake in a loser-out game Thursday in the 4A bi-district boys basketball tournament in Bonney Lake.
